mapper.sql: m.complaint_master_id, m.site_id, s.site_code, s.site_name, m.master_code, m.master_name, m.description, m.menu_id, m.notice_html, m.allow_member_yn, m.allow_oauth2_yn, m.allow_nice_yn, m.captcha_yn, m.show_in_list, m.file_yn, m.file_count_max, m.file_size_max, m.answer_required_yn, m.answer_deadline_days, m.use_yn, m.delete_yn, m.created_by, m.created_ip, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_ip, m.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_complaint_article a WHERE a.complaint_master_id = m.complaint_master_id AND a.delete_yn = 'N') AS article_count

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_complaint_master ( complaint_master_id, site_id, master_code, master_name, description, menu_id, notice_html, allow_member_yn, allow_oauth2_yn, allow_nice_yn, captcha_yn, show_in_list, file_yn, file_count_max, file_size_max, answer_required_yn, answer_deadline_days, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{complaintMasterId}, #{siteId}, #{masterCode}, #{masterName}, #{description}, #{menuId}, #{noticeHtml}, #{allowMemberYn}, #{allowOauth2Yn}, #{allowNiceYn}, #{captchaYn}, #{showInList}, #{fileYn}, #{fileCountMax}, #{fileSizeMax}, #{answerRequiredYn}, #{answerDeadlineDays}, #{useYn}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_complaint_master SET master_name=#{masterName}, description=#{description}, menu_id=#{menuId}, notice_html=#{noticeHtml}, allow_member_yn=#{allowMemberYn}, allow_oauth2_yn=#{allowOauth2Yn}, allow_nice_yn=#{allowNiceYn}, captcha_yn=#{captchaYn}, show_in_list=#{showInList}, file_yn=#{fileYn}, file_count_max=#{fileCountMax}, file_size_max=#{fileSizeMax}, answer_required_yn=#{answerRequiredYn}, answer_deadline_days=#{answerDeadlineDays}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE complaint_master_id = #{complaintMasterId}
